records.title: Markdown narrative
records.summary: Use Markdown for the explanatory text that an LLM or editor can revise safely. The template converts it into the application layout at compile time.

records.title: Structured application data
records.summary: Use JSON or CSV for metrics, records, status values, and asset identifiers. Change the schema and components together when adapting this project to an application.
